summary: When zombie villagers, husks, drowned or zombified piglins are damaged, they spawn regular zombie reinforcements
description:
## The bug

When zombie villagers, husks, drowned or zombified piglins take damage, there is a chance (depending on difficulty setting it seems) that a zombie will spawn.

It is not clear what the expected behavior for these zombie types should be: Spawning zombies of the same type or not being able to spawn reinforcements at all.

However, for zombie villagers spawning zombie villager reinforcements might allow building a farm based on this, which might or might not be desired.

Note: For zombified piglins ("zombie pigmen" at the time) this was partially fixed in 20w14a by setting their base zombie.spawn_reinforcements value to 0. However, it appears that if a zombified piglin spawns as leader ("Leader zombie bonus"), then it is still possible for it to spawn zombies. The same also applies when setting a custom zombie.spawn_reinforcements value in the NBT or via commands.

## How to reproduce

 - Be in the nether or the end (the overworld works too, but there will be natural zombie spawning as well)

 - Set the game difficulty to hard, and ensure the gamerule mobGriefing is set to true

 - Spawn a bunch of zombie villagers, husks, drowned or zombified piglins. Example: 

/summon minecraft:zombified_piglin ~ ~ ~ {Attributes:[{Base:1.0,Name:"zombie.spawn_reinforcements"}]}

 - Go into survival mode

 - Damage the mobs for a while

 → Zombie reinforcements are spawning

## Expected behavior

Regular zombie reinforcements would not be spawned when entities that aren't zombies with the minecraft:zombie.spawn_reinforcements attribute are attacked. Instead, for example, if a zombified piglin with this attribute were to be attacked, it would summon zombified piglin reinforcements and not zombie reinforcements.

## Code analysis

Code analysis by marcono1234 can be found in this comment.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Enter the Nether or the End.
2. Set the difficulty to Hard and set `mobGriefing` to `true`.
3. Spawn a group of zombified piglins using `/summon minecraft:zombified_piglin ~ ~ ~ {Attributes:[{Base:1.0,Name:"zombie.spawn_reinforcements"}]}` repeatedly.
4. Switch to Survival mode.
5. Damage the spawned zombified piglins repeatedly.
6. Continue damaging them for at least a few minutes.
7. Observe that regular zombie reinforcements spawn instead of zombified piglin reinforcements.
Observed Behavior:
## Actual behavior

When a zombie villager, husk, drowned, or zombified piglin takes damage, it can successfully trigger the zombie-reinforcement mechanic under conditions where reinforcements are allowed, such as on Hard difficulty. The reinforcement that spawns is always a regular `minecraft:zombie`, rather than a mob of the same variant as the damaged entity.

This occurs even though these mobs are not the standard zombie entity and, in some cases, do not normally have a positive `minecraft:zombie.spawn_reinforcements` value. For zombified piglins, the default value was set to `0`, but a zombified piglin that receives the leader-zombie bonus can still spawn regular zombies. Setting a positive `minecraft:zombie.spawn_reinforcements` value through NBT or commands also enables this behavior.

As a result, damaging groups of these mobs can produce regular zombie reinforcements, with the number of zombies depending on the reinforcement chance and applicable difficulty rules.
Expected Behavior: When zombie villagers, husks, drowned, or zombified piglins are damaged, they should not spawn regular zombies as reinforcements. If one of these variants is eligible to summon reinforcements, the spawned mobs should match the type of the damaged entity—for example, a zombified piglin should summon zombified piglins rather than ordinary zombies.
